purpose: Define bounded secure transport session lifecycle from configured peer through signaling, handshake, protected channel readiness, active exchange, expiry/cancel/error and cleanup.

topics.name: Secure Session Lifecycle
topics.purpose: Define bounded secure transport session lifecycle from configured peer through signaling, handshake, protected channel readiness, active exchange, expiry/cancel/error and cleanup.

semantics.transition_rule: State transitions are explicit and observable.
semantics.ready_rule: Application payload is accepted only after required handshake/protection state reaches secure_ready/active.
semantics.timeout_rule: Discovery/signaling/handshake/session idle/expiry limits are explicit and finite.
semantics.cleanup_rule: All terminal paths release transient signaling/channel/session-key resources.
semantics.identity_rule: Session lifecycle state never redefines peer semantic identity.
semantics.reauth_rule: Transport session renewal does not replace IAM/AccessCore reauthentication where resource policy requires it.
semantics.failure_rule: Failure never silently downgrades to an unprotected channel.

invariants.rule: Transport session, cryptographic material, signaling metadata and semantic identity remain separate; secure transport never implies application authorization.

hard_gates.condition: application payload accepted before required secure state
failure downgrades silently to insecure transport
transport renewal bypasses required IAM/AC reauth
